name: commit
description: Execute an approved planning-git-commits plan in order, then optionally push.
template:
Execute the approved planning-git-commits plan in plan order, each commit with its grouped files and message.
{{#if scope}}
The plan must cover: {{scope}}. Stop before committing if it omits any of them.
{{/if}}

1. Check for pre-commit hooks. Without hooks, commit every planned commit normally. With hooks, commit all but the last with `--no-verify`, then the last normally so the hooks run once.
2. If the hooks pass, offer to push (skill step 5): confirm the remote and branch, then push. Never force-push.
3. If the hooks fail: fix a simple lint or format failure, re-stage with `git add --`, and retry once. Anything else, or a failed retry: stop, show the log, and ask. Never loop.

variables.name: scope
variables.label: Scope
variables.description: Optional files the plan must cover. Leave blank when the approved plan is already in context.
